svg.title: How signals trims the graph
svg.desc: Every function in Codebase Memory as a bar as long as its cognitive complexity, tests in grey. signals drops the tests, ranks the rest by cognitive complexity, then cyclomatic, then length, and cuts the ranking at a fixed budget of rows. The rows on either side of the cut are tied, but a running total beside the ranking shows the rows the agent reads already hold most of the complexity, while each unread row adds a sliver. The head is what the agent reads, under a heading that names that order. A key explains cognitive, cyclomatic, and hidden_quadratic.
svg.text: how hard it is to follow; every level of nesting adds more
how many independent paths run through it
a linear search inside a loop
the head of the ranking, its order named
